frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Closing a DCF with a terminal value `TV_N` that summarizes all cash flows beyond the explicit forecast horizon. Gordon-growth-perpetuity and exit-multiple are the two canonical forms; the stable-growth constraint `g < r_f` and reinvestment-consistency `g = RR · ROC` bound the inputs. TV typically dominates the headline DCF, so sensitivity to terminal growth and discount rate must be reported.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Terminal Value and Sensitivity
